name: claymorphism
label: Claymorphism
css: .style-claymorphism { background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); border-radius: 48px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.08; pointer-events: none; } .style-claymorphism .hook { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--text, #1C398E); color: var(--text, #1C398E); margin: 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 85%; } .style-claymorphism .step { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--text, #1C398E); opacity: 0.08; position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 48px; line-height: 1; margin: 0; z-index: 1; } .style-claymorphism .brand { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 48px; z-index: 2; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; } .slide-code.style-claymorphism { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); } .slide-code.style-claymorphism::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-claymorphism .hook, .slide-code.style-claymorphism .text, .slide-code.style-claymorphism .step, .slide-code.style-claymorphism .brand { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-code.style-claymorphism .step { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); } .slide-code.style-claymorphism .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); } .slide-insight.style-claymorphism { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-claymorphism::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-claymorphism .insight-text { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; } .slide-insight.style-claymorphism .step { color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); } .slide-insight.style-claymorphism .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); }
